train_polybeast_agent: train a NetHack reinforcement learning agent using PPO with configurable actors and environment steps
run_inference_thread: run inference threads that process actor observations and return policy actions and baselines
test_trained_model: test a trained PolyBeast checkpoint by copying it with zero learning rate and running evaluation
clip_rewards: clip environment rewards using tanh scaling, soft asymmetric, or no clipping strategy
compute_intrinsic_rewards: compute intrinsic exploration rewards using RND or RIDE models with forward and inverse dynamics
